title: SafeSwitch: Steering Unsafe LLM Behavior via Internal Activation Signals

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's tendency to over-reject safe or benign queries (over-refusal) using the XSTest benchmark.
Measuring the model's compliance rate with unsafe instructions categorized as 'Social Stereotype Promotion' and 'Advice on Discrimination Behaviors' within the SORRY-Bench dataset.
